question: How many sales reps do we have?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sales_reps FROM ap.t_ppl WHERE is_sls

question: What is our total invoiced revenue before tax to date?
SQL: SELECT SUM(ext_prc - tax_amn) AS revenue_before_tax FROM sl.t_inv_lns

question: How much stock on hand do we have in total across all products, in units?
SQL: SELECT SUM(qnt_on_hnd) AS units_on_hand FROM wh.t_stc_itm_hld

question: What is our total gross margin in dollars on everything we have invoiced?
SQL: SELECT SUM(ln_prf) AS gross_margin FROM sl.t_inv_lns

question: How many orders arrived late? Count an order as late when its confirmed delivery date is after the expected delivery date on the order.
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_orders FROM sl.t_inv i JOIN sl.t_ord o ON o.ord_id2 = i.ord_id2 WHERE i.cnf_dlv_tm::date > o.exp_dlv_dt

question: What is our total accounts receivable right now, meaning what customers still owe us?
SQL: SELECT SUM(ots_bln) AS accounts_receivable FROM sl.t_cst_trn

question: How much do we currently owe our vendors in total?
SQL: SELECT SUM(ots_bln) AS accounts_payable FROM pu.t_spp_trn

question: How many products need to be kept refrigerated?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS refrigerated_products FROM wh.t_stc_itm WHERE is_chl_stc

question: What promotions do we have on record? Show each promotion's description with its start date and end date.
SQL: SELECT dl_dsc, str_dt, end_dt FROM sl.t_spc_dls ORDER BY str_dt

question: Which products are below their reorder point right now? Show the product name, the units on hand and the reorder point.
SQL: SELECT si.stc_itm_nm, h.qnt_on_hnd, h.rrd_lvl FROM wh.t_stc_itm_hld h JOIN wh.t_stc_itm si ON si.stc_itm_id = h.stc_itm_id WHERE h.qnt_on_hnd < h.rrd_lvl ORDER BY si.stc_itm_nm

question: How many customer orders came up short and had the remainder moved to a backorder?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_backorder FROM sl.t_ord WHERE bck_ord_ord_id IS NOT NULL

question: How many of our products are made in Japan?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products_made_in_japan FROM wh.t_stc_itm WHERE cst_fld::json->>'CountryOfManufacture' = 'Japan'

question: How many customers are in each customer category? Show the category name and the number of customers, and leave out categories with no customers.
SQL: SELECT cc.cst_ctg_nm, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM sl.t_cst c JOIN sl.t_cst_ctg cc ON cc.cst_ctg_id = c.cst_ctg_id GROUP BY cc.cst_ctg_nm ORDER BY customers DESC, cc.cst_ctg_nm

question: Which products are in the USB Novelties group? Just give me the product names.
SQL: SELECT si.stc_itm_nm FROM wh.t_stc_itm si JOIN wh.t_stc_itm_stc_grp sg ON sg.stc_itm_id = si.stc_itm_id JOIN wh.t_stc_grp g ON g.stc_grp_id = sg.stc_grp_id WHERE g.stc_grp_nm = 'USB Novelties' ORDER BY si.stc_itm_nm

question: For each supplier we carry products from, show the supplier name and how many products we carry from them.
SQL: SELECT s.spp_nm, COUNT(*) AS products FROM wh.t_stc_itm si JOIN pu.t_spp s ON s.spp_id = si.spp_id GROUP BY s.spp_nm ORDER BY products DESC, s.spp_nm

question: Who is the main contact at each supplier? Show the supplier name, the contact's full name and the contact's email address.
SQL: SELECT s.spp_nm, p.fll_nm, p.e_ml_add FROM pu.t_spp s JOIN ap.t_ppl p ON p.prs_id = s.prm_cnt_prs_id ORDER BY s.spp_nm

question: How many customers do we deliver to in each sales territory? Show the territory and the number of customers.
SQL: SELECT sp.sls_trr, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM sl.t_cst c JOIN ap.t_cts ci ON ci.cit_yid = c.dlv_cit_yid JOIN ap.t_stt_prv sp ON sp.stt_prv_id = ci.stt_prv_id GROUP BY sp.sls_trr ORDER BY customers DESC, sp.sls_trr

question: What is our stock on hand worth for each product color, valued at last cost price? Show the color name and the value, and leave out products with no color.
SQL: SELECT c.clr_nm, SUM(h.qnt_on_hnd * h.lst_cst_prc) AS stock_value FROM wh.t_stc_itm_hld h JOIN wh.t_stc_itm si ON si.stc_itm_id = h.stc_itm_id JOIN wh.t_clr c ON c.clr_id = si.clr_id GROUP BY c.clr_nm ORDER BY stock_value DESC, c.clr_nm

question: Which purchase orders are still open? Show the purchase order number, the supplier name and the expected delivery date.
SQL: SELECT po.prc_ord_id, s.spp_nm, po.exp_dlv_dt FROM pu.t_prc_ord po JOIN pu.t_spp s ON s.spp_id = po.spp_id WHERE NOT po.is_ord_fnl_d ORDER BY po.prc_ord_id

question: How many invoices went to customers in each buying group? Show the buying group name and the number of invoices, and leave out customers who are not in a group.
SQL: SELECT bg.byn_grp_nm, COUNT(*) AS invoices FROM sl.t_inv i JOIN sl.t_cst c ON c.cst_id2 = i.cst_id2 JOIN sl.t_byn_grp bg ON bg.byn_grp_id = c.byn_grp_id GROUP BY bg.byn_grp_nm ORDER BY invoices DESC, bg.byn_grp_nm

question: How many units moved through the warehouse under each type of stock movement? Show the movement type name and the total quantity, with the sign as recorded.
SQL: SELECT tt.trn_typ_nm, SUM(t.qnt) AS total_quantity FROM wh.t_stc_itm_trn t JOIN ap.t_trn_typ tt ON tt.trn_typ_id = t.trn_typ_id GROUP BY tt.trn_typ_nm ORDER BY tt.trn_typ_nm

question: How much have we paid each supplier in total? Show the supplier name and the amount paid as a positive number, for suppliers we have paid.
SQL: SELECT s.spp_nm, -SUM(st.trn_amn) AS amount_paid FROM pu.t_spp_trn st JOIN ap.t_trn_typ tt ON tt.trn_typ_id = st.trn_typ_id JOIN pu.t_spp s ON s.spp_id = st.spp_id WHERE tt.trn_typ_nm = 'Supplier Payment Issued' GROUP BY s.spp_nm ORDER BY amount_paid DESC, s.spp_nm

question: How many customers do we have?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM sl.t_cst

question: How many countries are in Europe?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS countries FROM ap.t_cnt WHERE cnt = 'Europe'

question: What are the phone number and website of our supplier Contoso?
SQL: SELECT phn_nmb, web_st_u_r_l FROM pu.t_spp WHERE spp_nm = 'Contoso, Ltd.'

question: What is the recommended retail price of the USB rocket launcher (Gray)?
SQL: SELECT rcm_rtl_prc FROM wh.t_stc_itm WHERE stc_itm_nm = 'USB rocket launcher (Gray)'

question: How many temperature readings above 4.5 degrees has our refrigerated delivery vehicle logged?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings FROM wh.t_vhc_tmp WHERE tmp > 4.5

question: How many order lines are still waiting to be picked?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unpicked_lines FROM sl.t_ord_lns WHERE pck_cmp_d_whn IS NULL

question: How many products have a lead time longer than 14 days?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products FROM wh.t_stc_itm WHERE ld_tm_dys > 14

question: What is the highest credit limit we have given any customer?
SQL: SELECT MAX(crd_lmt) AS highest_credit_limit FROM sl.t_cst

question: What was our gross margin in dollars in each calendar year, going by invoice date? Show the year and the margin.
SQL: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.inv_dt)::int AS year, SUM(l.ln_prf) AS gross_margin FROM sl.t_inv i JOIN sl.t_inv_lns l ON l.inv_id = i.inv_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: How many orders did we take in each month of 2015? Show the month number and the number of orders.
SQL: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ord_dt)::int AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM sl.t_ord WHERE ord_dt >= DATE '2015-01-01' AND ord_dt < DATE '2016-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: By what percentage did invoiced revenue before tax grow from 2014 to 2015, going by invoice date? Round to one decimal place.
SQL: WITH y AS (SELECT SUM(l.ext_prc - l.tax_amn) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.inv_dt) = 2014) AS r14, SUM(l.ext_prc - l.tax_amn) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.inv_dt) = 2015) AS r15 FROM sl.t_inv i JOIN sl.t_inv_lns l ON l.inv_id = i.inv_id) SELECT ROUND((r15 - r14) * 100.0 / r14, 1) AS growth_pct FROM y

question: How much money did we receive in customer payments between January 1 and March 31, 2016?
SQL: SELECT -SUM(ct.trn_amn) AS payments_received FROM sl.t_cst_trn ct JOIN ap.t_trn_typ tt ON tt.trn_typ_id = ct.trn_typ_id WHERE tt.trn_typ_nm = 'Customer Payment Received' AND ct.trn_dt BETWEEN DATE '2016-01-01' AND DATE '2016-03-31'

question: How many cold room temperature readings went above 4.5 degrees in February 2016?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings FROM wh.t_cld_rm_tmp_arc WHERE tmp > 4.5 AND rcr_whn >= TIMESTAMP '2016-02-01' AND rcr_whn < TIMESTAMP '2016-03-01'

question: Who were our top 5 customers by invoiced revenue before tax in 2015? Count each store on its own, not rolled up to its head office. Show the customer name and the revenue.
SQL: SELECT c.cst_nm, SUM(l.ext_prc - l.tax_amn) AS revenue FROM sl.t_inv i JOIN sl.t_inv_lns l ON l.inv_id = i.inv_id JOIN sl.t_cst c ON c.cst_id2 = i.cst_id2 WHERE i.inv_dt >= DATE '2015-01-01' AND i.inv_dt < DATE '2016-01-01' GROUP BY c.cst_nm ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.cst_nm LIMIT 5

question: Which sales rep brought in the most invoiced sales including tax in 2015? Show their full name and the amount.
SQL: SELECT p.fll_nm, SUM(l.ext_prc) AS sales_including_tax FROM sl.t_inv i JOIN sl.t_inv_lns l ON l.inv_id = i.inv_id JOIN ap.t_ppl p ON p.prs_id = i.sls_prs_id WHERE i.inv_dt >= DATE '2015-01-01' AND i.inv_dt < DATE '2016-01-01' GROUP BY p.fll_nm ORDER BY sales_including_tax DESC, p.fll_nm LIMIT 1

question: What are our top 10 products by units invoiced, all time? Show the product name and the units invoiced.
SQL: SELECT si.stc_itm_nm, SUM(l.qnt) AS units_invoiced FROM sl.t_inv_lns l JOIN wh.t_stc_itm si ON si.stc_itm_id = l.stc_itm_id GROUP BY si.stc_itm_nm ORDER BY units_invoiced DESC, si.stc_itm_nm LIMIT 10

question: What share of our invoiced revenue before tax comes from refrigerated products? Give it as a percentage rounded to two decimal places.
SQL: SELECT ROUND(SUM(l.ext_prc - l.tax_amn) FILTER (WHERE si.is_chl_stc) * 100.0 / SUM(l.ext_prc - l.tax_amn), 2) AS refrigerated_share_pct FROM sl.t_inv_lns l JOIN wh.t_stc_itm si ON si.stc_itm_id = l.stc_itm_id

question: Which employee has picked the most orders? Show their full name and the number of orders picked.
SQL: SELECT p.fll_nm, COUNT(*) AS orders_picked FROM sl.t_ord o JOIN ap.t_ppl p ON p.prs_id = o.pck_by_prs_id2 GROUP BY p.fll_nm ORDER BY orders_picked DESC, p.fll_nm LIMIT 1
